Overview.Name: Chaganti Harisha
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal, avoids non-veg on Monday and Saturday

Meal_1 (Main Lunch Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & sautéed vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & cooked vegetables
Meal_2 (Dinner - lighter): Option 2: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Curd rice (~150 g) + vegetable fry

Notes_and_Tips: Follow vegetarian meals on Monday and Saturday.
Fixed meal timing will help improve PCOS symptoms and cravings.
Start meals with eggs, chicken or paneer before eating rice.
Morning sunlight exposure and consistent yoga will support hormone balance and fat loss.
